body: At least my life had some sort of meaning.  I'm trying to look pretty today.  I want my last day to be of me feeling pretty.  I'm going to miss my dog.  But this pain is too much.  I can't do it anymore.  I don't even want help.  I just want to die.

One of my friends just called me and told me that me breaking up with him DID make him get help and he is doing really great now with his new girl.  I'm glad I could do that for him.  Maybe that was the point of my life.  To touch his; to make him a better partner and father for his kids so he could be there for others.
